name: spin-gentle
description: Handoff validation at moderate speed: 1.5 A to spin up through the cold start, drop to 0.3 A quickly so the unloaded rotor settles at a moderate speed (the current loop is only marginally stable at high w_e until the AC-L/decoupling work lands), then unload. 1 kHz capture (10 kHz drive capture blocked on the ISR-glue refactor).
